# state at instant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stateAtInstant`](gmeow-stateAtInstant.md)

- Use to scope a point-like location state to a single instant.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an interval-scoped state (use [`gmeow:stateDuringInterval`](gmeow-stateDuringInterval.md)).
